cell_type_context: primary human macrophages
limitations: Cell/stimulus-specific; primary macrophage evidence.
notes: RelA recruitment/knockdown at TNF; p65/p50 promoter study corroborates.

cell_type_context: human THP-1-derived macrophages; human U937 corroboration
limitations: THP-1 model; p50 effects are dimer/context dependent.
notes: NFKB1 loss increased IL6; independent p50 occupancy at IL6 promoter corroborates.

cell_type_context: human breast cancer-derived cells; HUVEC corroboration
limitations: Cancer-cell context; direct human promoter evidence.
notes: STAT3-site mutagenesis/ChIP and activation link CCND1; HUVEC ChIP corroborates.

cell_type_context: human ER-negative breast cancer cells; primary human astrocytes
limitations: Opposing polarity across cell type/stimulus; direction not portable.
notes: RelB/IL6 promoter support in breast cancer conflicts with RelB-mediated IL6 suppression in astrocytes.

cell_type_context: human MCF-7 breast cancer cells
limitations: Cancer-cell promoter/ChIP context; not a universal tissue claim.
notes: Exact human PR promoter regulation by ERalpha; independent human breast-cancer induction study.

cell_type_context: human CYP24A1 promoter reporter; Caco-2 cells in corroboration
limitations: Promoter-reporter and occupancy evidence in epithelial models; cofactor/context dependent.
notes: Exact human CYP24A1 promoter induction by VDR signaling; independent Caco-2 VDR-binding study.

cell_type_context: LNCaP human prostate cancer cells; human prostate tissue in corroboration
limitations: Prostate cancer model; glucocorticoid receptor can also activate the PSA promoter.
notes: Functional human PSA/KLK3 ARE/ARR evidence; independent AR recruitment and KLK3 upregulation study.

cell_type_context: human osteocalcin promoter reporter; MG-63 human osteoblast-like cells in corroboration
limitations: Human promoter tested partly in heterologous/VDR-positive reporter systems; response is cell-state dependent.
notes: Exact human osteocalcin/BGLAP promoter VDRE activation by VDR; independent human osteoblast-like VDRE-binding study.

cell_type_context: human intestinal/colon cell model
limitations: CEBPA acts with CDX1 in the human system; corroboration is a mouse preadipocyte promoter study.
notes: PMID 19059241 links CEBPA functional interaction to human PPARG transcription; PMID 10862621 independently shows C/EBPalpha binding and activation of the PPARgamma2 promoter.

cell_type_context: human HeLa/Saos2/SH-SY5Y cancer-cell models
limitations: Cancer-cell models and TAp73/p73 promoter isoform context.
notes: PMID 11988839 maps functional E2F1 sites in the human TP73 promoter; PMID 14602923 independently verifies E2F1-mediated p73 promoter activation.

cell_type_context: HepG2 and primary human hepatocytes
limitations: Promoter regulation is stimulus- and phosphorylation-sensitive in hepatocytes.
notes: PMID 11402042 identifies HNF4 binding at the CYP7A1 BARE; PMID 16323215 independently links HNF4alpha occupancy to human CYP7A1 transcription.

cell_type_context: human IGF2-H19 locus tissue-culture cells
limitations: CTCF repression is allele- and methylation-dependent; the primary study includes human/mouse ICR systems.
notes: PMID 10839547 shows CTCF binding blocks enhancer access to IGF2; PMID 19956766 independently links CTCF-mediated human-locus topology to IGF2 expression.

cell_type_context: human A549 alveolar epithelial cells; primary human SAEC
limitations: Context-specific TGF-beta1/SMAD3 evidence; cooperative SMAD3/SMAD4 promoter mechanism.
notes: Exact human promoter support; independent human ChIP/response study corroborates.

cell_type_context: human HaCaT keratinocytes; HepG2/carcinoma cells
limitations: Cooperative Sp1-dependent promoter mechanism; not a SMAD4-only site.
notes: Exact human SMAD4-p21 activation supported; independent human carcinoma study corroborates.

cell_type_context: human T47D breast cancer cells
limitations: Mammary epithelial/cancer model; hormone-dependent activation.
notes: Human STAT5A binding and activation of the beta-casein promoter are independently supported.

cell_type_context: human K562 CML cells
limitations: Antisense supports STAT5A dependence; promoter corroboration includes STAT5-family binding.
notes: Human STAT5A antisense lowers BCL-X_L; independent human STAT5 promoter study corroborates.

cell_type_context: NIH3T3 cells with human FOS promoter; human HeLa/U937 cells in corroboration
limitations: SRF/ternary-complex and stimulus dependent; not a universal ELK1 regulon claim.
notes: PMID 7889942 shows ELK1-dependent human FOS promoter activation; PMID 19789270 independently verifies ELK1 binding at the human c-FOS promoter.

cell_type_context: Human mammary carcinoma lines; human HepG2/HCT116/BT-474 models in corroboration
limitations: ERBB2 promoter activity is cell-context and AP-2 isoform/cofactor dependent.
notes: PMID 8895516 identifies AP-2alpha binding and activation of the human ERBB2 promoter; PMID 15870067 independently supports AP-2alpha-dependent ERBB2 promoter occupancy and activation.

cell_type_context: Human MeWo melanoma and HeLa reporter systems
limitations: Promoter/enhancer reporter evidence in pigment-cell models; not an SCI cell-context claim.
notes: PMID 7969144 shows human MITF transactivation through the TYR distal element; PMID 7969139 independently verifies MITF activation of the human tyrosinase promoter.

cell_type_context: Human monocyte/macrophage models; THP-1 cells in corroboration
limitations: Myeloid-lineage promoter and stimulus context; evidence is promoter-specific rather than a universal IL1B claim.
notes: PMID 7799967 maps two PU.1 sites and requires SPI1 for human IL1B promoter activity; PMID 11823535 independently confirms stimulus-induced SPI1 binding and promoter dependence.

cell_type_context: Human Caco-2, MG63, and HeLa cells
limitations: Exact primary studies support opposite context-dependent polarities: activation in differentiation/HDAC-inhibitor models versus repression of basal productive elongation in HeLa.
notes: PMIDs 11064455 and 10485470 support SP3 activation of CDKN1A/p21; PMID 23401853 reports SP3 repression, so polarity is held unresolved.

cell_type_context: Human HEK293 and postmortem parietal cortex; rat cortical neurons in corroboration
stimulus_context: Neuronal depolarization/KCl; Ca2+-responsive BDNF promoter IV
limitations: Human evidence centers on promoter IV and activity/overexpression assays; corroboration is rat neuronal evidence.
